headline: Uganda secures Shs113 billion climate finance for cutting deforestation
summary: Uganda has secured 113 billion shillings, about $31 million, from the Green Climate Fund for verified reductions in deforestation and forest degradation. The funding was announced at the launch of the Uganda REDD+ Results-Based Payments Project.
why: The Green Climate Fund channels international finance to climate projects in developing countries. Results-based payments link funding to measured emissions reductions.
